reasoning: The stem describes recurrent symptomatic hypoglycemia temporally linked to a new exercise routine while the prior meal and insulin plan remains unchanged. C3 is therefore the best-supported condition. A3 addresses immediate preparedness and treatment, while A2 addresses individualized prevention without unsafe independent insulin changes. P1 and P2 directly evaluate recurrence and the exercise-associated glucose pattern.
selectionEvidence: Symptoms and CGM readings of 58–64 mg/dL repeatedly occurred during cycling or within one hour afterward, supporting C3.
The client continued the preexisting insulin and meal plan without an exercise-day adjustment, supporting individualized planning through A2.
Documented symptomatic glucose below 70 mg/dL supports carrying rapid carbohydrate and immediately following the hypoglycemia plan in A3.
The repeated cycling-day episodes make symptom timing and recurrence below the glucose threshold in P1 directly relevant.
The temporal relationship to exercise supports monitoring glucose before, during, and for several hours after cycling as specified in P2.
